meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: The RBI's liabilities and assets, Issue and Banking Departments combined (the Weekly Statistical Supplement's first table), every week since July 2004
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 39 (data provider DP2), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Amounts in ₹ crore. 2317 cells the source prints more than once with different values (2012-02-17, 2012-08-03, 2012-05-04, 2025-09-26 and other dates) are left out: we cannot tell which value is right. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (17 values, e.g. 2.1 Central Government on 2009-07-03; 2.1 Central Government on 2009-07-31; 2.1 Central Government on 2012-11-09).
